name: AP-3 attack droid
description: The AP-3 attack droid (Assault Platform-3), also known as an AP-3 was a battle droid used by the Imperial Remnant. The AP-3 resembled an astromech droid, but it was armed with six missile launchers and micro-proton torpedoes. It also possessed a repulsorlift drive that enabled it to move quicker across the battlefield at the order of an AP-1-C.
